reason: The target comparison is uniquely identified as the Experiment 1 replication of Caruso et al. (2008) Study 1 testing temporal location (past vs. future) on monetary valuation in the self-relevant condition (Supplementary Table B, Hypothesis 1a), rather than the combined 2x2 self/other Experiment 1 sample (N = 423, derived from 425 responses minus 2 complete non-responders) used for the Study 4 factorial replication. However, the primary manuscript contains an unresolved internal reporting conflict for the exact analyzed sample size of this primary unexcluded comparison: Section 2.2 (p. 8) states that 'about half (n = 213)2 of the total 423 participants responded to the self-relevant scenario in a future or past setting' and 'We analyzed the data with the full sample for all experiments, which we report here', whereas the main-text summary Table 7 (p. 20) explicitly reports Replication N = '211' for the same Study 1 monetary judgment / temporal location effect (d = 0.03, 95% CI [-0.24, 0.30]), and Section 3.2 (p. 13) reports 't(421) = -0.22; p = .82; d = 0.03, 95% CI [-0.24, 0.30]'. Separate supplementary robustness analyses report distinct excluded subsamples—including N = 418 across the full design after preregistered English/seriousness exclusions (p. 21, self-relevant subset n unstated), n = 211 (t(209) = -.27, d = 0.04; total N = 420) after z-transforming monetary values and excluding >3 SD outliers (p. 33; Table R, p. 39), and n = 202 (t(200) = -.1.72, d = 0.24; total N = 406/404) after excluding valuations >= $200 (p. 26; Table K, p. 32)—and no positive text in the manuscript or supplement reconciles the discrepancy between Section 2.2 (n = 213), Table 7 (N = 211), and Section 3.2 (t(421)) for the primary analysis.
